# Vendor Security Questionnaire
**ISO 27001:2022 — A.5.19, A.5.20 | Version 1.0**
**Send to: Critical and Important suppliers before engagement and annually thereafter**

---

## Instructions

Please complete this questionnaire and return it within 10 business days. Where you hold an ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, or equivalent certification, you may attach the relevant certificate and report in lieu of answering sections marked **[CERT]**.

Organization completing this questionnaire: ____________________
Contact name and role: ____________________
Date completed: ____________________

## Scoring Guide (for assessor)

| Section | Weight | Score |
|---------|--------|-------|
| Organization & Governance | 10% | /10 |
| Data Handling | 20% | /20 |
| Access Control | 20% | /20 |
| Technical Security | 20% | /20 |
| Incident Response | 15% | /15 |
| BCP/DR | 10% | /10 |
| Physical Security | 5% | /5 |
| Total | 100% | /100 |

**Risk Rating:**
- 90-100: Low risk — approved
- 70-89: Medium risk — approved with conditions
- 50-69: High risk — requires remediation plan before approval
- < 50: Critical risk — do not engage without executive approval
